keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"keep_inline_images_in\":[\"a\"]}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/file.pdf\"><img src=\"pdf.png\"><p>Download PDF</p></a>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
